_comment: Shared defaults for every brand. build_brand.py merges this under each brand (brand.json, then brand.overrides.json win), so edit a value here once for all brands, or override it per brand in <slug>/brand.overrides.json. Set "stats": false in a brand's overrides to hide the column.

items.label: Higher conversion
items.copy: App sessions convert at a median 1.8x the brand’s mobile site (21 retailers, like-for-like).

items.label: Total revenue
items.copy: Fashion brands’ average revenue lift after launching an app, across $31.5B of Shopify orders.

items.label: Higher order value
items.copy: 80% of retailers saw higher average order values in-app, with a median uplift of 9% (21 retailers, app vs mobile web).

items.label: Push opt-in
items.copy: UK brand AYBL got 74% of app users to opt in to push, which drives 10%+ of its revenue.
